operators.customDisplayName: Load 2024_CSN_Data_Contributors.csv via pd.read_csv with skiprows=3 to skip title/section rows so the real header is parsed as ['Year','Data Contributor','# of Reports','%']

operatorProperties.code:
def process(ftcContributors) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = ftcContributors.copy()

    # Keep only valid year rows 2022-2024
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].between(2022, 2024)]

    # Focus on FTC web fraud reports
    df['Data Contributor'] = df['Data Contributor'].astype(str)
    df = df[df['Data Contributor'].str.strip().eq('FTC - Web Reports (Fraud & Other)')]

    # Parse '# of Reports' like '693,789'
    reports = (
        df['# of Reports']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df = df.assign(reports=pd.to_numeric(reports, errors='coerce'))

    out = pd.DataFrame([{
        'totalWebFraudReports2022to2024': int(df['reports'].sum(skipna=True))
    }])
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Filter ftcContributors to Year in [2022, 2023, 2024] (coerce Year to numeric, drop non-year footer/header rows); filter Data Contributor == 'FTC - Web Reports (Fraud & Other)' (web fraud); parse '# of Reports' by removing commas and coercing to numeric; sum across 2022-2024 and return single-row DataFrame with integer totalWebFraudReports2022to2024
